fields.description: A group from the OIDC token. Every row whose group the token carries grants its role, so several groups add up instead of competing.
fields.label: Group

fields.description: The role granted while the user is in that group, and taken away when they leave it. A row left empty - as "Fetch Groups From Provider" leaves the rows it imports - is ignored at login: it grants nothing and does not count as a match.
fields.label: Role
